current_source_review.interpretation: Original capture and baseline revisions, authority, KEEP_INCUMBENT disposition, feature and migration prohibitions, independent terminal gates, and child evidence receipts remain unchanged. Current child pins and projections include each child's explicit current-source review; the retained historical baseline is not a claim that current files are identical to that revision.
reviewed_changes: K0.1 adds the now-tracked fuzz/Cargo.lock pin and three consumer diagnostic type groups. K0.2 adds producer/consumer raw-property configuration, rebalance protocol, rebalance diagnostics, and transient-error diagnostics. The aggregate contains 912 primary IDs, including 901 core definitions and 11 historical contradiction inputs, with 135 exact authority references.

The source rollup contains 267 rows across 248 unique paths. Its 15 overlap groups still contain 34 rows, with no conflicting current hashes. The 67-path fixture union and eight historical fixture profiles remain unchanged; K0.4 explicitly qualifies the mixed SASL audit source separately.

Twelve existing semantic usage rows now have reviewed local references in the real-broker, native-constructor, or SASL-audit source. Their preservation and K14 synthesis requirements remain true; the remaining 40 UNKNOWN semantic usages and all seven external-search UNKNOWN rows still block migration.

The declared call-site grammar contains 249 name-collision exclusions in the same 34 groups. K0.3's current documentation census retains 9279 owned unresolved occurrences, including five added by the reviewed ADR and DEFLATE source annotations; no UNKNOWN is removed merely because a hash changed.

All 87 route rows, 126 owner edges, 49 owners, and seven aggregate claim states are retained. The full-row route digest includes K0.2's explicit current-source secret-redaction disposition while preserving its original finding. Child claim projection changes include reviewed current source locators; they do not promote source or test declarations to runtime evidence.

policy.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN is admissible only for a stable identified row selected by the declared ledger, with an exact owner and later resolution gate; it remains migration-blocking.
policy.blocked_rule: BLOCKED never defaults to supported, executed, or migration-eligible.
policy.internal_k0_handoff_rule: A route into an included K0.1-K0.4 child is satisfied only as an inventory handoff; executable authority must continue through that child's later-owner routes.

canonicalization.record_count_semantics: Rust str::lines semantics: one record per logical line, with no synthetic empty record after a final LF.
canonicalization.id_set_semantics: Bytewise sort unique UTF-8 IDs and serialize each ID followed by one LF.
canonicalization.typed_primary_semantics: Serialize bytewise-sorted stage<TAB>collection<TAB>id records with one trailing LF per record.
canonicalization.canonical_json_semantics: Recursively sort object keys, emit compact JSON, bytewise sort records by child, collection, and id, and append one LF per record.
canonicalization.source_pin_row_semantics: Wrap each source-pin row as an object with child, collection, id, and row fields; sort by child, collection, and id; recursively sort object keys; emit compact JSON with one LF per record.
canonicalization.route_row_semantics: Wrap each child route row as an object with child, collection, id, and row fields; sort by child, collection, and id; recursively sort object keys; emit compact JSON with one LF per record.
canonicalization.route_edge_semantics: Bytewise sort unique stage<TAB>gap-or-finding-id<TAB>owner records and append one LF per record.
canonicalization.aggregate_claim_semantics: Sort claims by claim_id, recursively sort each claim object's keys, emit one compact JSON object per claim, and append one LF per record.

source_pin_rollup.overlap_pin_tuple_rule: For each source-pin row whose path occurs in more than one child packet, serialize path<TAB>child<TAB>pin_id<TAB>sha256; bytewise sort the records and append one LF per row.

exact_joins.mapping_rule: Bytewise sort unique k0_1_profile_id<TAB>profile_id records and append one LF per row.
exact_joins.limitation: DOWNSTREAM-NO-KAFKA, NATIVE-KAFKA-RELEASE, TEST-INTERNALS-NO-KAFKA, and UNIT-WITH-KAFKA each map to two K0.3 profiles.

exact_joins.mapping_rule: Bytewise sort unique pin_origin<TAB>source_pin_id<TAB>fixture_id<TAB>path records and append one LF per row.
exact_joins.limitation: The twentieth K0.4 direct pin is the K0.3 authority artifact and is intentionally outside the fixture census.

exact_joins.mapping_rule: Bytewise sort unique classification_profile_id<TAB>fixture_id<TAB>path records and append one LF per row.

exact_joins.right_locator: unique route-owner IDs matched against .beads/issues.jsonl issue IDs

authority_id_joins.mapping_rule: For each authority reference, serialize left_child<TAB>left_collection<TAB>id<TAB>K0.3<TAB>right_collection<TAB>id; bytewise sort the records and append one LF per row.

lexical_name_collisions.mapping_rule: For every atomic site classified EXCLUDED_NAME_COLLISION, recursively key-sort and compactly serialize an object with the parent group_id, parent path, and the complete site object; bytewise sort the records and append one LF per row.

explicit_owned_unknowns.owner_edge_tuple_rule: Bytewise sort unique unknown_id<TAB>resolution_owner_bead records and append one LF per row.

selector_projection.selection_rule: Scan every top-level array row in K0.3 and K0.4 and select rows with any direct string-valued field exactly UNKNOWN, BLOCKED, or BLOCKED_EXTERNAL; additionally select every K0.3 owned_unknowns row with synthetic matched state OWNED_UNKNOWN.
selector_projection.tuple_rule: For each selected row, lexically sort and deduplicate matched states, join them with commas, then bytewise-sort stage<TAB>section<TAB>id<TAB>owner<TAB>matched-states records and append one LF per row.

selectors.owner_join: owned_unknowns by subject plus executable vectors by environment_ids

unknown_disposition.owner_join_rule: Every selected row has a direct owner field, the declared environment-to-vector/owned-unknown join, or an explicit indirect_owner_joins row; every resulting owner exists in the routed owner set or an independent terminal gate.
unknown_disposition.promotion_rule: UNKNOWN, BLOCKED, NOT_RUN, UNPINNED, planned, static, compile-only, local-model, wire-only, proof-only, opt-in, or silent-skip state cannot become PASS, REAL_BROKER_RECEIPT, ACTUAL_BINARY_RECEIPT, or migration evidence without a new terminal receipt.

gap_routing.route_projection_rule: Wrap each child route row as an object with child, collection, id, and row fields; sort by child, collection, and id; recursively sort object keys; emit compact JSON with one LF per record.
gap_routing.route_edge_projection_rule: Bytewise sort unique stage<TAB>gap-or-finding-id<TAB>owner records and append one LF per row.
gap_routing.internal_k0_handoff_projection_rule: Select route-owner edges whose owner is the included K0.2, K0.3, or K0.4 child bead; bytewise sort unique stage<TAB>gap-or-finding-id<TAB>owner records and append one LF per row.

claims_projection.canonicalization_rule: Sort claims by claim_id, recursively sort each claim object's keys, emit one compact JSON object per claim, and append one LF per record.
claims_projection.child_claim_canonicalization_rule: Wrap each child claim or no-claim row as an object with child, collection, id, and row fields; use the zero-based numeric array index as id for no-claim rows and the child's declared claim or evidence ID otherwise; sort by child, collection, and id; recursively sort object keys; emit compact JSON with one LF per record.
